_comment: Public texts of the task page and the scorecard (site/build.py). `title` and `subtitle` replace task.json's title; `preview_note` is a preview's status line (why it is not ranked yet); `references` and `baselines` describe each design in one sentence (the internal notes of task.json and tests/expected.json are never shown).
title: N × N matrix multiplication, clocked
subtitle: Multiply two signed N × N matrices, wrapping at AccW bits, behind a start/done handshake.
preview_note: The statement is being revised to cover the outputs on the wire and unknown values at reset; submissions are not ranked until then.
banlist_note: No operator is banned, `*` included: the task is the schedule (how many multipliers, how many cycles, how short a cycle), and the score prices it.

references.matmul_g1: N × N parallel multiply-accumulate units and one step counter: A and B are captured into shift registers at `start`, and `done` rises N steps later (latency N).
